description: Vanilla MinimalGPT+RoPE (exp328 architecture) with FFN replaced by LUT. Per-block: ln1 -> attn -> residual -> ln2 -> TinyMultiHeadLut(soft, H=1, NAP=6, tph=1024, n_out=n_embd) -> residual. Vanilla MLP (Linear(n,4n)+GELU+Linear(4n,n) = ~1.18M params/layer) replaced with LUT ~25.17M params/layer. Keeps: vanilla attention (qkv+proj), tied embedding (head.weight=tok_emb.weight), LayerNorm structure, RoPE on q,k. NEW: LION optimizer for LUT params (ndim>=3) with lut_lr=2e-4, betas=(0.9,0.95); AdamW for all other params. Total params ~165M (vs vanilla 23.2M, +7x). Bandwidth: vanilla FFN ~6.3 Mbits/layer × 6 = 38 Mbits trunk; LUT FFN ~12.58 Mbits/layer × 6 = 75.5 Mbits trunk. Reference: exp328 (vanilla bs=16) = 1.3882. This is the simplest possible LUT-vanilla hybrid.
